I've answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. No deadline has been settled. The only date anyone has given is Pree's note in #central-team on 14 October: the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. She gave no year.

That date has already passed for 2026. I asked Pree on the 14th whether she meant 2027 or a different date, and she hasn't replied. So I told Hollis to wait for her answer before updating the account sheet, and I tagged her in the thread to confirm.

I found nothing else about this deadline in the other channel Hollis is in that mentions Tansley Parcel (#inc-tansley-carrier-api). A deadline date isn't a money term, so it was fine to share with him.
